# Tool catalogue

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-docs.lisp from the tool registry. Do not edit. -->

**94 tools.** For parameters and JSON schemas, call `tools/list`; it is the canonical reference. Tools marked **user** need human approval (see [approval.md](approval.md)); **none** run immediately. Prefer `repl_*` over `swank_*`.
